main_text.p: Frustra hic Spinosæ quæras molimina mentis ;

Nequicquam Civis vtftigia prava jubentis. Horrida barbaries hic exulat: illita nullo Verborum fuco, strepituque immunis ab omni Sufficeens sibi sola, & opis nullius egena Seprodit cum matre fides, animofque subintrat.
Quicunque ergo alibi generosum quæris honestum
Et rationi obedire humilis jus esse putabis, Manibus autoris fortasse plura daturis Tellurem tenuem, verperpetuumque precatus Jamque datis utens, memorique ea mente revolvens
Disce hinc quid doceat ratio, natura, Deusque.

page.notes: Lower-right word "Nibi-" is a catchword at the foot. Some words are in italic throughout; Latin spellings such as "strepituque", "subintrat" are kept as printed. Marks "*" and small marks in the margins are not transcribed as text.
